ECDSAInvalidSignatureLength(uint256).details: The signature has an invalid length.

ECDSAInvalidSignatureS(bytes32).details: The signature has an S value that is in the upper half order.

activateZAccount(uint256[],((uint256,uin.details: It can be executed only after registering the ZAccount. It throws if the ZAccount has not been registered or it's registered but it has been blacklisted.

params.inputs: The public input parameters to be passed to verifier. (see `ZAccountActivationPublicSignals.sol`).
params.transactionOptions: A 17-bit number where the 8 LSB defines the cachedForestRootIndex, the 1 MSB enables/disables the taxi tree, and other bits are reserved.

returns.utxoBusQueuePos: The position in the UTXO bus queue.

batchUpdateBlacklistForMasterEoa(address.details: Only callable by the contract owner.

params.isBlackListed: The corresponding blacklist status for each master EOA.
params.masterEoas: The addresses of the master EOAs to update.

batchUpdateBlacklistForPubRootSpendingKe.details: Only callable by the contract owner.

params.isBlackListed: The corresponding blacklist status for each key.
params.packedPubRootSpendingKeys: The public root spending keys to update.

isAcceptablePubKey((uint256,uint256)).details: The pub key must be a point in the subgroup (excluding the identity) of Baby Jubjub curve points in the twisted Edwards form.

isZAccountWhitelisted(address).details: This function checks if a ZAccount exists and is not blacklisted.

returns.isWhitelisted: True if the ZAccount is whitelisted, false otherwise.

params.r: The r value of the signature.
params.s: The s value of the signature.
params.v: The recovery byte of the signature.

params.leaf: The leaf to use in the blacklist update.
params.proofSiblings: The proof siblings for the blacklist operation.
params.zAccountId: The ID of the ZAccount to update.

userdoc.notice: This contract manages the registration and activation of ZAccounts, which are secure accounts associated with public keys for private transactions. It includes functionalities for blacklisting master EOAs and public root spending keys, and provides mechanisms for ZAccount activation through UTXOs.
